name: GenSim
description: GenSim is a benchmark and dataset of over 100 robotic simulation tasks generated automatically using large language models. It aims to improve task-level diversity in robotic simulation environments and expert demonstrations, facilitating better generalization of robotic policies trained on simulation data.
reputation: A relatively new but well-cited robotics benchmark from the GenSim paper, mainly used in research on LLM-generated robot task diversity rather than as a long-established community standard.
notes: Includes goal-directed and exploratory task generation modes using GPT-4; improves sim-to-real transfer for robotic policies.
